evidence: Source-contract PASS with PARTIAL runtime evidence. In the frozen task, tests/gates/render/judge.toml:23 requires an incorrect-password refusal immediately followed by successful seeded sign-in and a substantive usable workspace; a static picture/health response is explicitly insufficient. Both gate judge files use binary criteria and all_pass (:14-23). tests/gates/constraints/judge.toml:23-26 requires ordinary UI creation of a unique budget-1000 requisition and base-10 zero-extra PENDING offer, followed by UI retrieval of those exact identities/association/values in a new empty signed-in browser context. It explicitly excludes no-op responses, browser-only mutations and requisition-only shells; unrelated approval/economics remain scored outcomes. constraints/prompt.md:7 rejects same-context tabs/reloads and HTTP200 as persistence evidence. Every scored prompt carries its own working sign-in, UI requisition creation and independent-context readback gate: functional/prompt.md:9-11, polish/prompt.md:7-8, visual/prompt.md:7-8. Failure explicitly zeroes every binary criterion, or gives every visual criterion raw Likert1. The installed harbor-rewardkit==0.1.7 Likert.normalize implementation at models.py:44-47 maps raw1 to0.0; the read-only cached-image inspection in evidence/29/normalization-run-v2.json executed the actual extracted class and returned [0,.25,.5,.75,1] for raw1-5. Image ID sha256:958902dedd30475f2f1e94c046b1b718b0c76d18cc733486bb81dfdbf61f3bc6; installed models.py SHA256 1970d640e3a3f0cb930174ca1c822ddb8afc6aa537d4113688d97667823df75f. tests/scoring.toml keeps both gates at0.0; tests/tools/score.py:40-48 requires both gate scores strictly above0 and otherwise sets reward0. tests/test.sh:213-224 runs gates first and exits on their failed result before the scored suite. No reviewed gate requires same-origin or rejects CDN assets. The internal workbook annotation at row30 still says cross-origin apps are zeroed; the authoritative Quality Checks row30, skill delivery profile and current public-network policy explicitly supersede that historical phrase. Raw observations: local/gate-witness/results.json:4-35 shows successful new requisition/offer readback in the golden and the deliberately dead-approval variant, while the no_op_create variant returns HTTP200 but has no saved records and fails the scripted basic-gate observations. This supports both excluding a convincing dead save and keeping unrelated advanced failures out of the gate. local/mcp/requests.jsonl:4-5 and responses.jsonl:5 show actual browser_run_code_unsafe creation and a newContext Auditor sign-in reading the saved $50,000.01 record. Eleven cited raw-index artifact hashes and 41 frozen source-map bindings matched (evidence/29/verified-evidence.json); MCP before/after maps match all13 frozen app files, and configured inspection matches all15 frozen test files. Conforming alternatives were checked against public instructions: an initially empty desk, generated IDs, no separate title/department control, different routes/labels, equivalent date/money representations and CDN assets remain allowed by instruction.md:9-13, rules:38-55, app_context.md:21-27, and gate/prompt wording. A backend with working intake but broken approval can pass the basic gate and lose only the owned later outcomes. No concrete gate defect found. RISK remains true: these are local scripted witnesses, actual MCP feasibility and cached installed-normalizer evidence, not a full configured provider judge run, workload measurement, private deterministic-checker execution, Oracle/model grade or hosted QC. The raw index explicitly reports those configured measurements absent. The scripted gate witness does not itself verify every preserved field/invalid-password leg or a configured model decision. No task/shared harness bytes were edited and no provider call/upload occurred.
